question: How did the legacy Influencer present data, and what modular projects provide useful patterns?

legacy_sources.finding: Entity line; latest subject-specific narrative titles/bodies with impact; transfer activity; plain-text SCORE/VIBE response; no generation when both narrative and heat collections are empty.
Adds previous vibe and relational memory as readable sections; SCORE/HOOK/VIBE response; no output schema.
Ollama endpoint changes from generate to chat, before the September 22 plugin migration.

controls.changed: Only model, from alibayram/smollm3:latest to ministral-3:3b.
controls.result: Unsupported details persist. Quiet scheduling acquires invented dates/season context; unrelated reporting produces a card rather than nulls. Pride/disappointment acquires unsupported relief and teammate-emotion wording.

controls.changed: Only user evidence presentation, from compact JSON to labeled text.
controls.result: Unsupported details persist; readable presentation alone is not a demonstrated cure.

controls.changed: Historical fixture system/evidence and legacy generate endpoint replayed on installed Ministral. Multiple factors differ from current path.
controls.result: The richer legacy material produces a different felt-read style; outputs drift from the requested plain-text format and exaggerate the quiet case. This does not recreate or disprove historical production quality.

interpretation: The task and evidence contract changed, along with output constraints, inference settings and transport. Current failures do not isolate plugin architecture as a cause or establish that 3B models cannot perform the intended task. Recover a genuinely successful historical production request as the next controlled baseline.

github_references.pattern: Separate system preamble, static/dynamic context and tools behind provider-independent orchestration.
Explicit document collection to prompt rendering to generation component flow.
Prompt plugins own their templates and accept explicit input variables; runtime invokes them.
Clearly delimit supplied context and put the concrete query immediately after it.
